Question 6

Prove that 9n−8 is odd if n is an odd integer.

Let n be an odd integer. Then, n=
2a+1
2a
2a+1
2a+1
for some integer a.

Therefore,
 
2(3a+1)+1
2(9a)
2(9a+1)
2(9a)+1
9(3a+1)
2(9a+1)+1
9n−8={(2(3a+1)+1)(S1)}.
